_about: Taxonomy for everyday / family / travel videos shot on phones and small cameras: people, kids, places, food, pets, activities. Copy into storyboard_project.json 'taxonomy' (as {"preset": "everyday_vlog", ...overrides}) to change it for one project.

categories.people_closeup: one or two people filling the frame (faces, reactions)
categories.talking_to_camera: someone talking to the camera / vlog or interview framing
categories.outdoor_scenery: landscape, nature, sky, water, city skyline
categories.street_walking: walking or moving through streets, paths, trails
categories.travel_transport: car, train, plane, boat, bike - getting somewhere
categories.indoor_home: at home or inside a building, everyday moments
categories.landmark_signage: landmarks, signs, place names with readable text
categories.closeup_detail: close-up of hands, objects, textures, details

subject_hint: personal footage from everyday life, family time or a trip
